libraries.name: Network layout
libraries.description: Physical network devices with socket-centred cable connections: consumer switches, routers and access points, plus matching 19-inch 1U switches, routers, firewalls and patch panels.

libraries.name: SPICE essentials
libraries.description: Standard onetransistor symbols with SPICE models and sources. Includes generic teaching models and a 741-style behavioral model.

libraries.name: Digital logic
libraries.description: Gates, counters and storage with educational SPICE models. Wire supplies to VCC and VSS; connect VSS to ground when required.

libraries.name: Functional blocks
libraries.description: Functional interfaces with configurable educational SPICE behaviour, including ADC/DAC, communication, state machines and programmable I/O.

libraries.name: Sensors and interfaces
libraries.description: Sensors, a test point, analogue switch and AM modulator with configurable educational SPICE models and explicit electrical terminals.
